verdict.comment: Kopek Des Bordes is the one to beat but there are several plausible each-way alternatives, notably WILLIAM MUNNY and Workahead.

comments.funiculifunicula: Won comfortably at Clonmel; now goes into much deeper waters but is highly unexposed
comments.irancy: Very lightly raced 7yo; impressive at Punchestown four months ago; potentially smart
comments.karbau: Looked good last time; related to a dual Cheltenham Festival winner for his yard
comments.karniquet: No match for stablemate Kopek Des Bordes in latest outing; now wears a hood
comments.kopekdesbordes: Impressive in Leopardstown Grade 1 event that regularly throws up winners at this meeting
comments.romeocoolio: Bagged a Grade 1 prize when last seen; second in the 2024 Champion Bumper; solid claims
comments.salvatormundi: Second to Sir Gino in sole French run; 2-2 this season and could well rate higher still
comments.skylord: No excuses in Grade 2 at Punchestown where he finished behind Salvator Mundi
comments.tripoliflyer: Has the better form of the two British contenders; lacks fluency but is progressive
comments.tuttiquanti: One of only two British runners; proving consistent but this looks a tough task
comments.williammunny: Registered an effortless Listed win at Punchestown last month; peaking at the right time
comments.workahead: Represents last year's winning yard and is a promising sort who comes here fresh

races.raceComment: kopekdesbordes is confidently preferred with a score of 62.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over romeocoolio. Won 1 of last 1 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 4/4 at cheltenham. Key attributes include superior ratings and strong course form and positive comments and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Stencil appears to have plenty going for him but QUANTOCK HILLS had valid excuses when behind the French raider here in January.

comments.beyondyourdreams: 1m4f Flat winner; progressing nicely over hurdles and trainer Joseph O'Brien targets this
comments.holysee: Respectable Flat form and a similar tale in his hurdling defeats; not exposed just yet
comments.hotfuss: His initial hurdle form reads well and forgiven final defeat; has since won on the Flat
comments.koolone: Three solid efforts this season and has the form to have some say in a race of this nature
comments.lavenderhillmob: Taken backward steps the last twice and this is a tough race in which to bounce back
comments.liamswagger: Recent Flat winner; unwise to knock latest defeat over hurdles; this race could suit him
comments.lukerstipple: In contention when falling late on in a Listed race last month; still looks up against it
comments.mistercessna: His Ludlow conqueror is going places but this gelding still isn't wildly appealing
comments.moutarde: It goes against the grain to trust one with his exposed profile in a race of this nature
comments.murcia: Unlucky not have won at Naas last time in a race that's been a great guide to this
comments.puturhandstogether: Needs to improve but a market mover this past week and trainer knows what's required
comments.quantockhills: Progressive until a below-par run here in a Grade 2 and he had excuses that day
comments.robbiesrock: Has won a handicap hurdle but this demands an almighty level of improvement
comments.slurricane: Won a handicap last time; an uncomplicated gelding who shouldn't be passed over lightly
comments.solardrive: Doing well as a hurdler and will win more races, but this is unlikely to be one of them
comments.sonybill: Lofty aspirations are shelved for now and Paul Townend takes over for handicap debut
comments.static: Useful juvenile hurdler but placed at best if he's lucky in this tough an assignment
comments.stencil: 2-3 in France; clear 2nd behind one of the Triumph favourites in Grade 2 here in January
comments.teriferma: Coming along nicely until struggling in a Grade 2 here; soft ground was a feasible excuse
comments.totallook: Has course experience and he's better than he showed on heavy ground last time
comments.turnandfinish: Made a meal of justifying hot favouritism in a modest Catterick maiden last month
comments.wendrock: Struggled in a Grade 1 last time; still unexposed and will enjoy the likely drying ground

races.raceComment: liamswagger is marginally preferred with a score of 53.8%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over puturhandstogether. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include strong course form, though step up in class need consideration.

comments.caesarrock: Four seconds in this sphere (at up to 3m) but his score over fences is now 0-19
comments.captaincody: Stayed 3m well at Navan (soft) on latest chase start, retaking third from Now Is The Hour
comments.dufflecoat: Won Mayo National (2m7f) last May; 2nd in the Galway Plate (extended 2m6f, good) in July
comments.gericaultroque: Big-race places (they read well) before a long layoff; encouraging return in January
comments.haiticouleurs: Second chase win was at Cheltenham (extended 3m1f, good to soft); can resume improvement
comments.hasthing: Creditable, never-dangerous fourth on first go at 3m and highly likely to stay beyond that
comments.herakleswestwood: Only struggled into third back at Newbury one month ago in his hat-trick bid over about 3m
comments.indor: Sandown third in hat-trick bid but again ran well and staying beyond 3m may be possible
comments.jupiterallen: Game, front-running win in first-time cheekpieces at Taunton (2m7f, soft) on latest start
comments.klarckent: Disappointing since fourth in Scottish National (4m, soft) last April; headgear first time
comments.kyntara: Jumps fences rather ponderously but he's well handicapped and likely to stay
comments.notimetowait: Close up on latest start when tongue tied first time and shaping like a stayer
comments.nowisthehour: Plenty of promise; highly interesting if effective on the likely very different ground
comments.resplendentgrey: Running creditably; needs to resume improvement; stayed on strongly over shorter trips
comments.rockmyway: Remote second of five on latest outing; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces
comments.stuzzikini: Experienced chaser who stays 3m2f well and has won a major 3m handicap at Navan

verdict.comment: Buraback is greatly respected after last week's unlucky third but PHOENIX BEACH looks an interesting alternative.

comments.beaumadier: Behind Buraback over C&D last week; this year's best gives him solid claims though
comments.betweenthesticks: C&D win off 2lb lower last October; had wind op since latest run; absence to overcome
comments.buraback: Two C&D wins in January and unlucky not to add to his tally here last week; big player
comments.emjaykay: 6f win here last November; reliable in defeat since; can go well back at 5f
comments.gustavgraves: Conditions to suit and on a feasible mark; can go well despite his wide stall
comments.levelup: Return to Class 6 will help and he ran OK here last time; lower draw preferable though
comments.manonamission: Best efforts this winter have come at Kempton; others stronger back at 5f
comments.phoenixbeach: Good C&D record for current stable; had a short break and looks booked for another big run
comments.popdancer: On a losing run; down in the weights but others appeal more for win purposes
comments.tenclub: Back to his last winning mark but needs to leave last month's stable debut well behind

races.raceComment: betweenthesticks is marginally preferred with a score of 50.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over buraback. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The return to 7f shouldn't trouble ROGUE THUNDER and he's the one in this field who ran a respectable race last time out.

comments.amerigovespucci: Won a turf 1m handicap last year but doesn't arrive here in much form; stable debut latest
comments.capallcliste: Has the form to feature but he finished last in a 1m classified race on stable debut
comments.dodgybob: Veteran who is without a win since September 2023 and looks out of form
comments.greciangod: C&D winner who could strip fitter for recent Southwell run after a break
comments.hawajes: Well held in handicaps the last twice but he did win his last start in classified company
comments.mayremain: Multiple winner but hasn't shown much spark at all in his last four races
comments.rebelredemption: Ran some fair races in defeat last year and might be refreshed after a break
comments.roguethunder: Arrives here on the back of some respectable runs over 6f and stays this far
comments.starofatlantis: Modest last run but a good effort the time before and returning to 7f a positive
comments.tillitshines: Has run some of her better races over C&D and this is her first time in a classified

races.raceComment: hawajes is marginally preferred with a score of 48.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over roguethunder. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: It may be worth siding with HEAVENLY FIRE who has winning form in handicap company over C&D and drops to this level for the first time.

comments.alyara: Made a winning stable debut at Southwell in December, but hasn't matched that form since
comments.balmybreese: 0-23 and no obvious reason why he should reverse latest C&D form with Coconut Bay
comments.bignarstie: C&D winner who may be better over 1m now, but still worth a second look on stable debut
comments.coconutbay: Dual C&D winner, including three weeks ago; could enjoy the run of the race; every chance
comments.heavenlyfire: Sole win came in a 0-55 handicap over C&D; respected on her first go down at this level
comments.seathebuckthorn: Sole win in 28 starts came over C&D, but out of form lately and drawn widest
comments.shadesofmay: 0-6, but has a good chance on these terms and the return to this trip may help
comments.sochic: Last win came in a 0-65 handicap over C&D, but she has mainly been on a steady decline
comments.wrathofhector: Last two efforts not so good and one win from last 31 starts doesn't inspire confidence

races.raceComment: coconutbay is confidently preferred with a score of 53.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over sochic. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Although the two wins by RISING FORCE have been at Chelmsford he has form elsewhere and can win this. The main danger is Calanthe.

comments.alsuileile: Has six course wins but has been below form since returning from a break in December.
comments.alreetcha: Settled better in first-time hood (retained) when third of 12 at this track last Tuesday.
comments.calanthe: Just 2lb higher than when making a successful handicap debut at Lingfield in September.
comments.globalstyle: Both AW wins came in 2022 and has been off for 554 days; best watched on stable debut.
comments.hostelry: 8lb below her last win at Thirsk last April but is 0-10 on AW and returns from a break.
comments.kingofspeed: Landed his third win at Wolverhampton last month and nudged up 4lb.
comments.nosaint: Fell on home turn here when in rear in January and steps back up in trip.
comments.parishcouncillor: Won at Newcastle in February 2023 but fifth is the best he's managed in nine handicaps.
comments.possibleambition: Second on stable debut at Wolverhampton last February but two modest efforts subsequently.
comments.risingforce: Both wins have been at Chelmsford but good second at Kempton in January.
comments.timetobenice: Attempted to make all when second of seven at Kempton 13 days ago and holds place claims.
comments.visibility: He is 6lb below his last winning mark but his recent form is not encouraging

verdict.comment: Westmorian is high on the list but JESSE LUC (nap) is going from strength to strength and can deal with the step up in class.

comments.angelofengland: The odd good run this winter but the presence of other pace influences is offputting
comments.charliemason: Comes here in good form and fully effective at the track; each-way shout again
comments.jesseluc: Flourishing now, winning 4 of last 5; up 5lb in a higher grade but still a big player
comments.jumpthegun: 21lb lower than for his last win but doesn't look in the form required to capitalise
comments.leodisdream: Good 3rd on return last month but stopped quickly last time; 6f a major query
comments.matchplay: Came from the clouds to take 4th at Newcastle last time; 6f a query; slowly away this year
comments.mightypower: Hold-up performer who starts out for a new yard on a dangerous mark; one to consider
comments.rambusocreek: Dangerous mark on best form for K Ryan; sharper for last month's return; check betting
comments.tygerbay: Returning to 6f in his favour and this track holds no terrors; dangerous mark
comments.westmorian: Second in this race last year; promising return at Newcastle last week; solid contender

races.raceComment: jesseluc is marginally preferred with a score of 58.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over charliemason. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

form.rpCloseUpComment: raced in last, still plenty to do when switched right over 1f out, ran on but never near to challenge (inquiry held into running and riding of gelding which raced in rear throughout before staying on strongly down  home straight from an unpromising position to finish 4th of 7 runners, beaten 2 1/4 lengths; jockey stated his instructions were to jump out, sit in box seat and see how race developed from there; he explained that gelding had missed the kick and he therefore accepted his early position and decided to sit last; he indicated that he thought the pace was decent for first 2f before it steadied up leaving back straight on first circuit leaving him further out of his ground than had been intended; from this point in race and during middle stages jockey acknowledged that he was aware pace was slow but he was reluctant to make a forward move to improve his position for fear of getting trapped wide; in explaining his riding from leaving back straight on final circuit, he stated that he was again hesitant to switch wide, due to concerns he could end up at least 4 wide around outside of runners, so committed to ride for luck down inner in hope of obtaining a clear passage between rivals on rail or to the inside of a rival if runners fanned approaching home bend, which they often do at Wolverhampton, but it failed to materialise on this occasion and he was denied clear running for some distance approaching  2f marker; on straightening for home he managed to switch gelding to outside, mounting his challenge and gelding had stayed on very well through to line; trainer confirmed instructions; however expressed disappointment that even allowing for fact that gelding wasn't quickest into stride, greater effort had not been made by rider to ensure gelding settled more prominently and was ridden to instructions; trainer also indicated that he was dissatisfied with fact that jockey failed to switch wider and improve his position on to the back of favourite for some distance from approaching 3f marker until entering home straight; jockey told stewards he was still very inexperienced riding in staying races and only had approximately 50 career rides to his name)

verdict.comment: Nelson Gay and CATCH CUNNINGHAM appeal most, with the latter marginally preferred after a good run at Wolverhampton last month.

comments.alfamoonstone: Well beaten in two runs for new yard; need to see more before getting involved
comments.angleland: On a winning mark and this C&D winner should fare better than at Chelmsford last time
comments.birkenhead: Conditions no problem and on a winning mark; other pace to contend with today
comments.catchcunningham: On a fair mark and ran well for second at Wolverhampton last month; one for the shortlist
comments.itsshowtime: Good placed efforts over C&D the last twice; still to win on AW though & others preferred
comments.jeansmaite: C&D win 12 months ago came off 4lb higher; improving run by run this winter
comments.junglerun: C&D win last September was the final leg of a hat-trick; ran well after a break last March
comments.nelsongay: C&D win (Class 6) last month; ran well at Wolverhampton last week; each-way shout
comments.populardream: Both wins have come over C&D; return to this track a plus but others look better treated

races.raceComment: catchcunningham is marginally preferred with a score of 53.9%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over angleland. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
